preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call EnemyAddress(victim_address, true) to blacklist any target address. This will prevent the victim from making any transfers (buying or selling) since _transfer() checks _isEnemy mapping and reverts if either sender or receiver is blacklisted. The attack demonstrates improper access control where owner can arbitrarily block any address from transacting.
